note: 'and add gridlines behind the bars' is coordinated with the nonfinite 'to see' that ends the 'to' relation, so a command stands inside the clause where that relation starts.
'the same bolder' is written with 'bolder', the graded word, as the head of the nominal, so 'needs the same' loses the thing it needs.
'do the grid lines dashed' is a command whose verb is 'do', but 'do' is held as an auxiliary and the participle 'dashed' is made the verb of a clause with 'the grid lines' as its subject.
'bar faces blcak' is written with 'blcak' as the head of the nominal and 'faces' as its dependent, so the colour word becomes the thing talked about and the faces only describe it.
'keep the surface colour black' splits the one nominal 'the surface colour', holding 'colour' as a modifier of the clause while 'the surface' keeps the head.
